prompt:
Create a polished professional architecture diagram as a wide landscape PNG, clean white background, dark navy typography, restrained teal and blue accents, subtle light gray card borders, crisp simple icons, generous whitespace. This is a use-case flow for an OpenAI Cookbook tutorial. Make all text highly legible and correctly spelled. No gradients, no 3D, no decorative photo backgrounds, no logo recreation. Title at top: "Product return evidence review". Subtitle: "Assess evidence, apply rules, prepare human review".
Arrange four columns left to right with clear thin arrows between them.
COLUMN 1 heading "Customer evidence" with three small stacked cards: "Customer message" (chat bubble icon), "Product photo" (small illustration of a dented blue metal bottle and cracked ceramic mug), "Order details" (document icon).
COLUMN 2 is one prominent teal-outlined card labeled "Decisions API", subtitle "POST /v1/decisions". Inside three tidy rows: "Reported issue" with small pill "choice"; "Photo usability" with small pill "predicate"; "Visible product damage" with small pill "predicate". Small footer in this card: "One request, three independent questions".
COLUMN 3 one navy-outline card labeled "Application rules". Three rows: "Validate answers", "Check order and return window", "Select next step". Clearly separate this card from the Decisions API card.
COLUMN 4 heading "Human handoff" and three stacked separate cards, each connected from Application rules: "Request information" with small sublabel "Customer support"; "Prepare for review" with sublabel "Returns agent"; "Specialist review" with sublabel "Returns specialist". Each card has a simple human outline icon.
Below columns 3 and 4, put a small light gray secondary panel "Local evaluation" with subtitle "Compare recommendations with expected outcomes". Connect a thin dotted arrow from Application rules down to this panel. Tiny separate label in the panel: "Reference labels stay local". No arrow from this panel or reference labels into the Decisions API.
Bottom caption: "Recommendations only. A person approves returns. No refunds or tickets are sent."
Keep the main flow visually dominant and the local evaluation panel secondary. Professional technical publication style, readable at README width, with exact text above and no extra prose.
